Title: Public preview: Scan and view lineage of data stored in Erwin Mart, Google BigQuery and Looker using Azure Purview

Body.Content:
Azure Purview now supports Erwin, Google BigQuery and Looker as sources. These sources support full scan to extract metadata from respective sources and fetch Lineage between data assets. 

For details, read the documentation.
